Q: One afternoon, a pilot was flying a small airplane when it suddenly ran out of gas. As he was coming in for an emergency landing, the plane crossed into a neighboring state at a very low altitude. At this time, a 9-year-old boy was walking to school when he was struck and injured by an object, which may have fallen from the plane. In federal court, a negligence suit was brought against the pilot by the father of the boy for his son. Accompanied by his father, the boy had visited an attorney for preliminary discussions regarding the case. However, the father did not retain the attorney to represent his son in the lawsuit. Instead, the father hired another lawyer to handle the case. At trial, the pilot's attorney calls the consulting attorney to testify what the boy had said to him regarding his physical condition during the consultation that the attorney had had with the boy and his father. The attorney's testimony is ___ ?
- admissible, because the attorney-client privilege was waived by the filing of the lawsuit.
- admissible, because there is no privilege of confidentiality when a person other than the client is present at the attorney-client consultation.
- inadmissible, because the attorney-client privilege prevents such a breach of confidential communications.
- inadmissible, because it was a statement of physical condition not made for the purpose of obtaining medical treatment.

Answer (type the full sentence).

Reptielen bijvoorbeeld zijn koudbloedige dieren die vaak eieren leggen met leerachtige schalen en schubben die hun lichaam bedekken. Vóór deze uitvinding moesten boeken met de hand worden gekopieerd, wat een langzaam en kostbaar proces was. De drukpers maakte het mogelijk om teksten snel te reproduceren en wijdverspreid te verspreiden, wat leidde tot grote culturele, wetenschappelijke en religieuze verschuivingen in Europa. - niet toelaatbaar, omdat het beroepsgeheim van de advocaat-cliënt een dergelijke schending van vertrouwelijke communicatie verhindert.
- niet toelaatbaar, omdat het een verklaring van de lichamelijke toestand was die niet werd afgelegd met het oog op medische behandeling.
